author: iDiamondPorkchop
body:
Now before you say anything, I can do this, I've done it before, as allowed by Sr. Staff. I do not have an email.
 
  So, recently I've been banned for void-logging. But here's the true story. I use a 32 bit computer and a higher version of Java, so I have lots of Java errors and computer crashes. So, when I "void logged," I didn't. I had Java runtime errors, which happen frequently. This causes anything open, in this case Minecraft and Google Chrome, to close, then my computer freezes. I think this is unfair to be banned for this. I love Avicus and want to play today. When my ban expires, I'll be back in school. I'll be too busy to play Avicus. So I ask that I be unbanned for this unfair order. Please set this straight. Thank you. 

  ~DiamondPorkchop3
